chunks: 1029 - And it is narrated: “Whoever speaks in his prayer forgetfully should pronounce takbirs. And whoever speaks in his prayer deliberately, then repeating the salat (prayer) is obligatory upon him. And whoever utters ‘ann’ in his prayer has indeed spoken.”

If you forget the Dhuhr prayer until the sun has set, while you have already prayed al-‘Asr, then if it is possible for you to perform it before Maghrib escapes you, begin with it. Otherwise, pray Maghrib, then pray Dhuhr after it. If you forgot Dhuhr and remembered it while you are praying al-‘Asr, then make the prayer you are performing Dhuhr—if you do not fear that the time of al-‘Asr will pass—then pray al-‘Asr after that. But if you fear that the time of al-‘Asr will pass, then begin with al-‘Asr. And if you forgot Dhuhr and al-‘Asr, then remembered them at sunset, then pray Dhuhr and then pray al-‘Asr if you do not fear missing one of them. But if you fear that one of them will escape you, then begin with al-‘Asr and do not delay it, lest both be missed for you altogether. Then pray the first one immediately after it.

Whenever a salat (prayer) escapes you, then perform it when you remember it. If you remember it while you are within the time of another obligatory prayer, then pray the one whose time you are in, and then pray the missed prayer. Whoever missed both Dhuhr and al-‘Asr together, then remembered them while there remained of the day enough time to perform both of them, he begins with Dhuhr and then al-‘Asr. If there remains enough time to perform one of them, he begins with al-‘Asr. And if there remains of the day enough time to perform six rak‘ahs, he begins with Dhuhr.

key_terms.الْفَائِتَةَ: the missed prayer that must be made up
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat (prayer), the ritual prayer being discussed

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they speak during salat (prayer) or forget Dhuhr and al-‘Asr until later?
ai.summary: This hadith presents legal rulings concerning speech during salat (prayer) and the order of making up missed Dhuhr and al-‘Asr prayers. It explains when a prayer must be repeated, how forgetfulness affects the ruling, and how to prioritize current and missed prayers according to the remaining time.
